tasks.short: Run internal theft and policy investigations

steps.what: File a theft or policy incident
Classify the report into a case type

loop.input: report text and the fixed case-type list
loop.output: one case type and a deadline from the report date
loop.check: The type is theft, policy breach or other, and the note does not say anyone is guilty
loop.stop: One pass, then the manager sets the type if none fits
loop.why_not_simpler: Reports often name both a theft and a policy breach, so a keyword rule mis-files them

steps.what: Interview staff and record the facts
Give an account in the interview
Draft the status from logged facts

loop.input: logged facts and the status template
loop.output: status note that cites fact ids only
loop.check: Every cited fact id is on the interview notes or the report
loop.stop: Drop any sentence with no fact id and stop after one draft
loop.why_not_simpler: What the facts mean for a sanction is not a fixed lookup

steps.what: Sign the finding and any sanction
Route the signed finding to the owner

tasks.design: The store supervisor files store id, date, policy id and the free-text facts on a {WORKFLOW} form. A bounded pass classifies that report, and a later note in {DOCS} may cite only logged facts. The loss prevention manager signs one finding version, including any sanction, and only that version is routed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports lived in mail and interview notes, so a case had no type, no deadline and no single fact list a status note could cite.
tasks.enabler_now: A report can carry a store id, a date, a policy id and a fact list that a register can route to a named owner.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an account is credible, and whether a sanction is fair, stays a human call.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides if the logged facts support a finding and any sanction.

ambition.what: Close or escalate each case by its deadline instead of in a monthly pile

tasks.altitude: The week moves from chasing notes to interviews and sanctions. The manager can refuse a case whose facts are not in the log.

reach.task: Add evidence to a signed internal case
reach.learn: Which finding version is current and which facts are still missing

evidence.claim: Internal theft cases in a mid-size retailer are mostly interviews and a written finding. The register is the part with a stable shape.
Digest [S3] says a protocol library forwards incident reports to the person in charge. Routing here sends only a signed finding, and does not judge the case.

Digest [S8] says one hospital's incident register grew from 125 reports to tens of thousands after a new register. That is more reporting, not fewer incidents, so a fuller case list is not counted as less theft.
Digest [S9] says decisions about people must not rest on automation alone. Any sanction in this task is signed by the manager.
Digest [S12] says works council consent is required for staff monitoring. This case opens from a submitted report, not from covert watching.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. The task ends when a signed finding version is routed. The disciplinary hearing is a later people task.

Input contract: store id, incident date, reporter role, policy id if known, free-text facts, names of people involved. Producer is the store supervisor. If the form is empty the manager types the same fields from mail and marks the row manual.
Use the workflow tool's own form and the document store's template before custom code. Template upkeep sits in incremental hours.

This is not covert surveillance. A case opens from a report. Any design that watches named staff needs works-council consent and is out of this task. A till or stock extract used as evidence is an operational exception list, not a hidden watch of named people.
unknowns: Whether the works council has already consented to investigation files that name staff.
Who may sign a sanction when the manager is absent.
Which policy ids exist for the common breaches.
research_questions: What share of reports lack a store id or a date?
How often does the signed finding change the first case type?

already_counted.description: Manager rewrites weak sentences in the status draft
Interview time stays in the room with the manager
Sanction and finding judgement stays with the manager

incremental.description: Keep case types, policy ids and deadline rules aligned with the signed policy
Store supervisors correct reports the form sends back

approvals.approved_version: case finding version signed in this review
the same signed case finding version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes many reports still arrive as free-text mail, so classification rarely sticks and every interview stays as it is. The high case assumes the form is used, but every interview and every sanction still takes the manager's time. The hearing itself is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer loss, inventory and safety programs

steps.what: Confirm which controls the store runs
Review programs past their review date
Draft the status from program rows

loop.input: program rows and the status template
loop.output: status note that cites program ids only
loop.check: Every cited program id is on the overdue list and every threshold matches a row
loop.stop: Leave a blank and stop that section if a number has no row
loop.why_not_simpler: Why a store cannot run a threshold is not a fixed merge

steps.what: Meet on a disputed program change
Sign this period's program version
Apply the signed thresholds in operations
Acknowledge the signed program in store

tasks.design: Store supervisors submit control id, current threshold and proposed threshold on a {WORKFLOW} form. A {BI} list shows programs past their review date, and a bounded note in {DOCS} drafts the status from those rows only. The manager signs one program version, and only that version changes thresholds in the {OPS_SYSTEM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program rules sat in old documents and mail, so a threshold change could not be tied to a signed version.
tasks.enabler_now: Each program can carry an id, an owner, a review date and the control it changes, and the operations system can take a threshold by that id.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a safety or count threshold that stores can actually run is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager accepts or refuses the threshold and the review date.

ambition.what: Reset a program's review date every month instead of once a year

tasks.altitude: Routine programs are signed from the row list. The manager keeps the disputed ones, and can block a threshold that has no signed version.

reach.task: Run the signed count or safety control in the store
reach.learn: Which program version is current and which review is overdue

evidence.claim: Administering loss and safety programs is a register of controls plus threshold changes. The meeting is for disputes, not for every store.
Digest [S2] says a GRC platform has compliance, audit, incident and regulatory-monitoring modules. Here it is a program register, not shop-floor watching.

Digest [S1] says a policy library versions documents, maps them to rules, and a model classifies and summarises regulatory text and flags gaps. That is used only for the policy text inside a program, not to watch the shop floor.
Digest [S12] says works council consent is required for staff monitoring and rosters. This program register does not monitor named staff or build a roster.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. The task ends when a signed program version is published and its thresholds are applied. Store execution of the control is a later task.

Input contract: program id, store id, control id, current threshold, proposed threshold, review date, owner. Producer is the store supervisor for a store request and the manager for a company program. A row with no control id stays on a manual list.
Configure the operations system's own threshold fields and the workflow form before custom code.

The meeting share in the prior is high. Most of this task is the program register and the operations console. Only disputed programs become a meeting. The register is not a hidden watch of named people.
unknowns: Which safety thresholds the operations system can store without a side workbook.
Who signs a program when the manager is away.
Whether any current program already collects named staff data.
research_questions: What share of programs has no owner or a review date in the past?
How often does a store reject a threshold after it is signed?

already_counted.description: Manager edits the status before the meeting
Disputed-program meeting time stays with the manager
Program sign-off time stays with the manager

incremental.description: Revise program fields when a new control type is added

approvals.approved_version: program version signed for this period

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes threshold fields are missing, so the manager still edits programs by hand and the apply step rarely runs. The high case assumes clean rows, but every disputed program and every signature still takes manager time. Store-floor execution is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review till exceptions and cash differences

steps.what: Open the exception reports and cash export
Apply the fixed cash and void rules
Judge the rows the rules leave open
Draft the note from the row fields

loop.input: exception rows and the note template
loop.output: one line per row citing till id and rule id
loop.check: Every till id and amount equals the export row
loop.stop: Stop a line when the row has no till id
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason a difference is still unexplained is not stored as a code

steps.what: Sign the close or the new case
File the signed close on the row

tasks.design: Fixed rules on the {ERP} till export flag a till id, a difference above the signed amount, a void, or a refund with no receipt id. The {BI} list shows only those rows. A bounded note in {DOCS} drafts one line from the row fields, and the manager signs the close or a new case. The list is an operational exception queue, not a watch of named people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exception rows were copied into a workbook, so a close could not point at a rule id or a till id.
tasks.enabler_now: The till export can provide till id, business date, difference, void count and receipt id, which a fixed rule can test.
tasks.still_hard: A row the rules cannot explain still needs the manager to decide whether it is an error or a case.
tasks.human_edge: The manager closes the row or opens a case, and refuses a close that has no rule id.

ambition.what: Close cash exceptions on the business day instead of in a weekly pile

tasks.altitude: Matching rows leave the queue. The manager's week is the unmatched differences, and a case cannot open without that signature.

reach.task: Attach the missing receipt to a till row
reach.learn: Which differences are already closed and which still need a receipt id

evidence.claim: Cash differences in this job are mostly a repeatable match of till id, amount and rule, plus a short list a person still judges.
Digest [S2] says a GRC platform has audit and incident modules. The exception list is an audit queue, not shop-floor watching.
Digest [S9] says decisions about people must not rest on automation alone. Closing a till row is not a sanction. If a row later becomes a case about a person, that decision stays with the manager.
Digest [S12] says works council consent is required for staff monitoring. These rules look at till and cash rows, not at named people.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. The task ends when each row is signed closed or opened as a case. The later investigation is a different task.

Input contract: store id, till id, business date, tender type, difference amount, void count, refund id, receipt id, rule id. Producer is the till export. A row with no till id stays on a manual list and is not closed by rule.
Use the finance system's own exception report and the workflow form before custom code.

The prior meeting share is low, and this design keeps the work on the screen and the note. Till exceptions are operational, not a hidden watch of named people. No person id is required to close a row.
unknowns: Which till differences are already explained by a known cashier procedure.
Who may sign a close when the manager is absent.
Whether the export includes a stable till id for every store.
research_questions: What share of rows fail for a missing receipt id rather than a true difference?
How many signed closes are reopened the next day?

already_counted.description: Manager still reads the export before the rules run
Judgement time on unmatched rows stays with the manager
Manager edits the discrepancy note before signing

incremental.description: Adjust the difference and void thresholds when tender types change
Store supervisors add receipt ids the rules reject

approvals.approved_version: exception close or case open signed for this till and date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the export has no stable till id, so the rules rarely fire and the manager still sorts the workbook. The high case assumes clean rows, but every unmatched difference and every close still takes a human decision. No loss figure is treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train stores on loss control measures

steps.what: Choose the topic and the audience
Draft the pack from the signed policy

loop.input: signed policy version and the pack template
loop.output: pack whose sections cite that version id
loop.check: Every section cites the signed policy version and states no score of a person
loop.stop: Stop if the policy version id is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Store examples in the pack are not a fixed extract of the policy text

steps.what: Sign the training pack version
Enrol the signed audience on the course
Deliver the session in the store
Record attendance without a behaviour score
Attend the session and mark presence

tasks.design: The manager names a policy version, a store and a role. A bounded draft in {DOCS} builds the pack only from that signed policy. The signed audience is enrolled on the {LMS}, and the session stays in the room. Attendance is recorded. No behaviour score is produced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Packs were copied from old files, so a session could teach a policy version that was no longer signed.
tasks.enabler_now: The policy register can supply a version id, and the learning system can enrol a role at a store without a separate list in mail.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a crew understood the control is only visible in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the topic, signs the pack, and runs the session.

ambition.what: Replace the pack in the same week a policy version changes, not at the next yearly session

tasks.altitude: Preparation shrinks to a check of the signed policy. The session stays the manager's, and a pack with no policy version cannot be enrolled.

reach.task: Release the crew for the signed session
reach.learn: Which pack version will be taught and which roles are enrolled

evidence.claim: Most of this task is the session in the store. The pack and the enrolment list are the parts that repeat from a policy version.
Digest [S1] says a policy library versions documents and a model summarises them. The pack may use only the signed policy version, and a person still checks it.
Digest [S15] says a paid report drafted with a model cited sources that did not exist. The pack is not taught until the manager checks it against the policy version.
Digest [S10] and [S11] say the AI Act Annex III includes evaluating staff on behaviour or traits. This design records attendance only and does not score staff.
Digest [S12] says works council consent is required for staff data. Enrolment is a named list, so consent is a precondition of the build.

assumptions: Focal role is the loss prevention manager. The task ends when the session is delivered and attendance is recorded. Designing a new company policy is out of scope.

Input contract: course id, policy version id, store id, role to attend, session date. Producer of the topic is the manager. Producer of completions is the learning system. If the policy version id is missing, the draft does not run and the manager writes the pack from the document.
Use the learning system's own enrolment and the document template before custom code.

The prior meeting share is mostly the session, which stays. Attendance is not a behaviour score and is not a covert watch. Works-council consent for the named list is settled before go-live, not by the draft.
unknowns: Whether the works council has consented to named attendance lists.
Which stores have no signed policy version to teach from.
Who may sign a pack when the manager is away.
research_questions: What share of sessions still use a pack with no policy version id?
How often does attendance fail to be recorded after the session?

already_counted.description: Manager edits the pack before signing it
Session time in the store stays with the manager
Topic choice stays with the manager

incremental.description: Update the pack template when a policy section is renumbered
Staff correct a missed attendance mark

approvals.approved_version: training pack version signed for this policy version
the same signed training pack version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes policy versions are missing, so the pack is still written by hand and only the enrolment form is new. The high case assumes the pack drafts cleanly, but every session and every signature still takes the manager's time. Time in the room is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager stops retyping case notes, program statuses and exception lists, and spends the week on interviews, sanctions, disputed programs and the training room.
reach: Store supervisors receive a routed case status and a signed program version instead of a chase mail.
Investigators receive the signed finding and the evidence list before they add the next fact.
skills_to_grow: Write an incident as fields a register can route and deadline.
Separate a till or stock exception from a case about a named person.
Keep the training session in the room and the pack on a signed policy version.
role.ambitious_version: Each store week opens on a routed case list, a current program version, a closed exception queue and one signed training pack.
